name: Worklist Prioritization Agent
fn: Scores and ranks overdue accounts daily on 20+ factors into collector worklists
detail: Scores and ranks every overdue account each morning on 20+ factors — exposure, days past due, risk tier, payment-history trend, dispute signals — into a collector-specific worklist. Focuses scarce collector time on the accounts that move DSO most.
sap: SAP FSCM-COL · dunning programme F150 · FI-AR aging (FBL5N) · customer master (KNA1 / KNB1 / KNVV)

io.in: AR aging · customer master · comms history
io.out: Ranked worklist · dunning · promises · cash forecast
